title: Living systematic review surveillance + re-screening
description: Search for new citations, deduplicate and re-screen them against the registered protocol, and prepare an update only when eligible evidence could alter conclusions.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: living-review-surveillance
  title: Living systematic review surveillance + re-screening
  description: Search for new citations, deduplicate and re-screen them against the registered protocol, and prepare an update only when eligible evidence could alter conclusions.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Detect new eligible studies that could change review conclusions and produce an auditable update decision.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 5, onFailure: preserve-completed, requireApprovalFor: [update-approval] }
  nodes:
    - id: review-snapshot
      kind: input
      name: Current review state and registered search strategy
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [reviewId, lastSearchDate, searchStrategy, existingCitations, currentConclusions]
        properties:
          reviewId: { type: string }
          lastSearchDate: { type: string, format: date }
          searchStrategy: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/json }
          existingCitations: { type: string, contentMediaType: application/json }
          currentConclusions: { type: string }
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: poll-sources
      kind: tool
      name: Run the registered search from the last search date
      summary: Host-resolved bibliographic search using the supplied registered strategy and date boundary.
      capabilities:
        skills: [research, evidence-provenance]
        tools: [search]
        connectors: [mcp:academic-research]
        permissions: [read-only]
    - id: dedup-against-existing
      kind: transform
      name: Remove citations already present in the review
      config: { operation: deduplicate, expression: $.newCitations against $.existingCitations by doi,pmid,title,year }
    - id: re-screen
      kind: agent
      name: Re-screen against the registered protocol
      templateRef: clin-05
      role: Independent systematic-review screener following a registered protocol.
      prompt: Apply the supplied inclusion and exclusion criteria independently. Return include, exclude, or uncertain with criterion-level reasons, and never resolve uncertainty by inventing missing study details.
      capabilities: { skills: [systematic-review-screening, protocol-adherence], tools: [read, classify], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: newly-included
      kind: transform
      name: Select newly included studies
      config: { operation: filter, expression: $.reScreened where decision == include }
    - id: impact-assessment
      kind: agent
      name: Assess impact on the existing synthesis
      templateRef: clin-11
      role: Senior evidence-synthesis reviewer assessing the impact of newly eligible studies.
      prompt: >-
        Compare newly eligible studies with the current synthesis outcome by outcome. Determine whether effect
        direction, magnitude, precision, applicability, risk of bias, or certainty could change, and classify the
        impact as none, minor, or major with source-linked rationale. Do not claim that conclusions changed without
        a compatible synthesis or enough reported data.
      capabilities:
        skills: [clinical-evidence-appraisal, statistical-analysis, decision-analysis, uncertainty-calibration]
        tools: [read, compare, calculate]
        permissions: [read-only]
      outputSchema: { type: object }
    - id: impact-gate
      kind: condition
      name: Does the new evidence warrant an update package?
      config:
        expression: impactAssessment.impact
        branches:
          - { label: No material impact, when: none }
          - { label: Minor impact, when: minor }
          - { label: Major impact, when: major }
    - id: prepare-update-package
      kind: transform
      name: Assemble the bounded update package
      config: { operation: select, expression: $.newlyIncluded + $.impactAssessment + $.searchProvenance }
    - id: update-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Review lead approves the surveillance decision or update package
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Approved update package or up-to-date declaration
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: review-snapshot, to: poll-sources, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: poll-sources, to: dedup-against-existing, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: dedup-against-existing, to: re-screen, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: re-screen, to: newly-included, kind: data }
    - { id: e5, from: newly-included, to: impact-assessment, kind: data }
    - { id: e6, from: impact-assessment, to: impact-gate, kind: data }
    - { id: e7, from: impact-gate, to: update-approval, kind: control, condition: none }
    - { id: e8, from: impact-gate, to: prepare-update-package, kind: control, condition: minor }
    - { id: e9, from: impact-gate, to: prepare-update-package, kind: control, condition: major }
    - { id: e10, from: prepare-update-package, to: update-approval, kind: data }
    - { id: e11, from: update-approval, to: result, kind: dependency, condition: approved }
